snippet.title: Gibbets 2! Draw back your bow in this truly unique game of skill!
snippet.description:
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.herocraft.game.free.gibbets2

BlackBerry World http://www.youtube.com/watch?feature=player_embedded&v=bXtBjy2CZio

App Store: https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/gibbets-2/id540348847

Tired of always losing at Hangman? Now it's time to get your own back on that noose-wielding bully!  Can you the handle the frantic pace and save the innocent before they take their final breath in this arcade puzzler?

Game features:

1. Draw back your bow in this truly unique game of skill.
2. Save the innocent people from hanging in over 50 challenging levels.  
3. Master the use of portals and pick ups across the colourful detailed landscapes.
4. Unlock awards and achievements for your expert bowmanship.
5. The sequel to the million selling hit PC and iPhone game Gibbets!

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/herocraft.games
Twitter: https://twitter.com/HeroCraft

©  Herocraft 2012
